name: nitroalkane oxidase (NAO)
notes: Organism not named in S024; found through its refs 11 (Kido et al. 1978, PMID 22538) and 24 (Daubner et al. 2002, PMID 11867731): UniProt Q8X1D8 (NAO_FUSOX) cites both. EC from UniProt (paper gives none). Asp402 of the paper = D402 in Q8X1D8 (match). 2C0U and 2C12 (residues 1–439) and 3D9G (2–439) are WT, identical to Q8X1D8. Excluded mutants: 2REH D402E, 2ZAF R409K, 3D9D/3D9E/3FCJ D402N, 3D9F S276A. No entry cites 10.1021/ja0484606; the paper names no PDB entry.

name: PheH (phenylalanine hydroxylase)
notes: Species not named in S025. Enzyme from ref 3 (Daubner et al. 1997, PMID 9305947), which no UniProt or RCSB record cites; rat inferred because the same lab's PheH structures (5FGJ, 5EGQ; Fitzpatrick P.F. among authors) are rat PheH P04176 — inference, check against ref 3. EC from UniProt. Full length (1–453); no residue numbers named. 5FGJ identical to P04176; 5DEN full length with T87S vs P04176 (not engineered). Not listed: 1PHZ and 2PHM (WT, residues 1–429 only), 5EGQ (R270K). No entry cites 10.1021/ja0562651.

name: Δ117PheH
notes: Truncated: lacks residues 1–117 (N-terminal regulatory domain; paper: 'mutant forms ... lacking the N-terminal regulatory domains'), i.e. residues 118–453 of P04176. Species as for PheH (inferred; ref 3 could not be opened). EC from UniProt. No rat PheH entry of this construct (human PheH catalytic-domain entries such as 1PAH and 1J8U are another species).

name: WT TyrH (tyrosine hydroxylase)
notes: Species not named in S025 (TyrH gift of P. Frantom; ref 6 = Frantom et al. 2002, PMID 11960436, not cited in UniProt). Rat inferred: P04177 (rat TyrH) cites Daubner/Moran/Fitzpatrick papers (PMIDs 10933781, 11922614) and the lab's TyrH structures 1TOH and 2MDA are rat. EC from UniProt. Full length; no full-length TyrH structure. WT-sequence domain structures (not listed): 1TOH and 2TOH (residues 156–498; 2TOH lists F300Y, the self-hydroxylated Phe300 of its citation title, not engineered), 2MDA (65–159, NMR).

name: TrpH102–416 (tryptophan hydroxylase)
notes: Species not named in S025 and not traceable with the permitted sources: construct from ref 4 (Moran et al. 1998, PMID 9575176), cited by no UniProt or RCSB record. Rabbit assigned from the reader's prior knowledge of ref 4 — unverified, check against ref 4; boundaries 102–416 fit TPH1 of rabbit, rat and human alike (444 aa each). Truncated: lacks the N-terminal regulatory domain (1–101) and C-terminal residues 417–444. EC from UniProt. No rabbit TPH1 structure in PDB (human TPH1 entries such as 1MLW and 5L01 are about 97–98% identical, another species).

name: formate dehydrogenase (FDH)
notes: Paper spells 'Candida bodinii' (Results) and 'Candida biodinii' (text, ref 28); strain and sequence not stated; EC from UniProt. The four WT entries differ from reviewed O13437 (FDH1) at E50G, T51N, E53V, K56Q, L79I, N84K, V128L, L184V, E202D, V227I, V354I (most annotated in O13437 as natural variants of strains 2.2159/NCYC 1513; not engineered) and are identical to TrEMBL A0A0A1EQY0, to which RCSB maps them; 5DN9 (NAD+/azide ternary complex) and 5DNA are from Guo et al. 2016 (same Kohen/Cheatum labs), so the S026 enzyme is probably the A0A0A1EQY0 sequence (not stated in S026). Excluded: 2FSS K47E, 2J6I K328V, 6D4B V123A, 6D4C V123G, 8IVJ V120T, 9KA8 (residues 1–355, extra A251P/T256P). Residues named in the paper (Arg-284, His-332, Ile-122, Asn-146) are Pseudomonas sp. 101 FDH numbering (PDB 2NAD author numbering, checked; = P33160 285, 333, 123, 147); by alignment they correspond to C. boidinii R258, H311, V93, N119 (O13437 numbering). No entry cites 10.1021/ja902120t.

name: WT NspLOX
notes: Construct = C-terminal LOX domain, residues 344–773, of a fusion protein (paper); lacks the N-terminal (catalase-like hemoprotein) domain. Strain not stated in the paper. Q8YK97 (Nostoc sp. PCC 7120, all8020, 773 aa, named NspLOX in UniProt) is the only LOX-family protein of that strain in UniProt; besides the LOX domain (UniProt 176–773) it carries catalase-superfamily/AOS signatures (CDD cd08151, SUPFAM heme-dependent catalase-like), consistent with the paper's fusion protein, and its length (773) matches 'residues 344–773'; refs 8 and 10 could not be opened. Numbering check: Q8YK97 562 is Ile, and the 'conserved isoleucine' seven residues C-terminal (paper; = SLO-1 I553) is I569 (match). EC from UniProt. No PDB entry (no RCSB hit at >= 50% identity over 344–773).

name: soybean lipoxygenase-1 (SLO), double mutant DM-SLO
notes: EC from UniProt (paper gives none). L546 and L754 (and I553, named in the text) match P08170. 4WHA (Hu et al. 2014, 10.1021/ja502726s = S028 ref 45) and 5TQO (300 K; 10.1021/jacs.8b10992) both list S160E in addition to L546A/L754A; S160E vs P08170 occurs in most SLO-1 entries (e.g. WT 3PZW, 5T5V) and was not engineered. Neither cites 10.1021/acscatal.7b00688.
